shared_or_similar_visual_information: A line or boundary made of separated short strokes.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It represents a hidden rear bottom edge of the cube. Right image: The dashed curve is the plotted graph of function g, distinguished from the solid graph f.
Rationales: The left dashes convey occlusion in a three-dimensional wireframe. The g label identifies the right magenta dashes as a plotted function, not an invisible edge. The two stroke styles therefore encode different contextual functions.
